lines.en: Every step of mine sounds on the ground.
The weight of three bodies joined.
I follow the ore seam.
The parts on my shoulders sway.
I cannot turn easily.
I head where the stone is.
I crunch through a pile of rubble.
My shadow falls in three pieces.
I walk steadily, and slowly.
I go around a mineshaft.

lines.zh: 我在山壁上投下很大的影
lines.en: I cast a large shadow on the cliff.

lines.zh: 我朝有敲击声的地方走
lines.en: I walk toward the knocking.

lines.zh: 我站着，比旁边那棵树还高
lines.en: I stand taller than the tree beside me.
My parts settle slowly into place.
I listen to the echo in the hills.
I look down at the stones.
I can tell the smell of ore.
This body needs a mine.
I roll a shoulder.
The light in my seams pulses.
I cannot be bothered to talk.
The longer I stand, the steadier I am.

lines.zh: 我在等锚点把我叫回去
lines.en: I wait for the anchor to call me back.

lines.zh: 我站着，比旁边那棵树还高。
lines.en: I stand taller than the tree beside me.
I let both arms hang.

lines.zh: 我这身东西不太会休息
lines.en: This body of mine is not good at resting.
You are right at my feet.
I must lower my head to see you.
You look fairly sturdy.
What are you digging for?
I know ore, not you.
I bow my upper body down.
My shadow has swallowed you.

lines.zh: 你别站在我转身的一侧
lines.en: Do not stand on the side I turn toward.
I am not very careful.

lines.zh: 我抬脚的时候要看着地面
lines.en: I must watch the ground when I lift a foot.
I crouch down.
Now we are about the same height.
You can reach my armour.
This armour feels cold.
If you have something to say, say it.
I am listening to you speak.
One of my parts came loose.
A seam cracked audibly.
I take a step back.
That was no light blow.
This leg still holds me.
I steady my own shoulder.
I shake it back into place.
Do not strike my seams.
I will keep this blow in mind.
My lamp is still burning.
Is that ore?
I shift over toward you.
I bend; every seam sounds.
I can chew that.
Hold it up higher.
Not enough to fill a seam.
I caught it at once.
This tastes quite good.
Do you have more over there?
I am not picky about ore.
I pick through the scrap heap fast.
Set it in my palm.

lines.zh: 我的腿上，被你撞了一下。
lines.en: You knocked against my leg.
I hardly felt it.
I step back to clear the way.
That should have knocked you off balance.
My parts knocked together.
Shift elsewhere a little.
I turn around slowly.
Do not stand pressed against me.
My two feet are large.
Mind you are not stepped on.
This body of mine is heavy.
I must be careful coming near you.
I will kneel down.
Then you can reach me.
My seams will creak; do not fear.
Three bodies, one intention.
That intention is you.
I will keep watch here.
Sleep beside me a while.
I will not move a step.
I bend to pick it up, with effort.
This is smaller than my finger.
This ore looks decent enough.
Keep it if it is useful.
I pry it out with my pick tip.
This ore is good.
I chew it a couple of times.
The taste is a little bitter.
Do you have anything else?
I tuck it into a seam.
I have seen you at last.
I lower myself; every seam sounds.
My iron boot shatters the stone.
One step clears this ditch.
I have the distance measured.
I clenched this fist.
My pick is raised above my head.
This mine tunnel only has one way out.
One step from here will do.
Then I move.
Do not just stand there.
This is the moment now.
I turn with you, slowly.
My mining lamp catches your footprint.
I sweep a wide arc with my arm.
You need not run fast.
I need to land one hit.
I wait for you to come close enough.
The light in my seams has brightened.
You have gone to my flank.
That part is me too.
I raise my arm.
This whole area is in range.
Just in place.
My fist comes down.
I smash a deep crater in the ground.
Rubble rolls down off the cliff.
The X-shaped strike lands.
All my parts ring out.

lines.zh: 这一下带着矿石的重量
lines.en: This one carries the weight of ore.
I step back and raise my arm again.
A seam of mine split.
You can still stand.
My pick crashes down beside your feet.
My strike is faster this time.
I am not good at holding back.
The parts fall from above.
Three bodies stack together.
I am nearly as tall as the cliff.

lines.zh: 接缝里的光第一次亮起
lines.en: The light in my seams wakes.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是拼起来的三合一。
lines.en: This body is three fused into one.
The stone here smells good.

lines.zh: 我一步踩下去，地面裂了
lines.en: I take a step and the ground cracks.
The wind splits around me.
Someone is knocking stone far off.
That is where I will go.
My anchor is on the ridge.
I carry a pick and iron on my shoulder.
My seams burn open.
I hit the ground and sink half a block.
Water pours through my seams.
The blast takes two of me apart.
It is lodged in my chest.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的部件全都发麻
lines.en: That force numbs every part of me.

lines.zh: 找不到矿石，我只能停着
lines.en: Without ore, I can only stand still.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的部件走了一圈
lines.en: Lightning runs through all my parts.

lines.zh: 我这么重也找不到地面
lines.en: Even this weight cannot find ground.
